interpretation: LP relaxation and cut re-solve time dominates these three named runs (about 96-100% of measured runtime). No broad performance gain is claimed. The targeted change is conservative singleton-row bound propagation before node relaxation; its effect on these instances has not been isolated from noise or established as an improvement.

proof_obligations.propagation_fields: node, source row, variable, source coefficient, source rhs, derived bound, source side
proof_obligations.validation: recording checks finite values, cut violation at the observed point, and singleton division; parsing has witness-value limits
proof_obligations.assurance: The replay checker ignores annotations and verifies the original-domain cut-free tree. Stripping annotations leaves acceptance unchanged. Notes do not certify global cut validity or source-row scope.
proof_obligations.remaining: Serial applied singleton and verified cut events are carried by milp::Result, and build_mip_proof accepts audit annotations. The forbidden API path still needs to pass those events into the builder; parallel workers need a synchronized collector. Independent cut-derivation checking also remains to be designed.

parallel_cuts.root: A failed root cut LP now leaves the root model unchanged; exceptions and failed LP status are reported to stderr.
parallel_cuts.in_tree: Worker-local helper and local-cut inheritance are implemented and tested concurrently, but process_node remains unhooked because that file is fenced for another agent.
